quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator sticks while driving?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to park.
Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.
Turn off the engine.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake firmly.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, keep looking at the road. Shift into neutral quickly. Press the brake pedal firmly. Then pull off the road safely and turn off the engine.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Speed up.
Railroad crossing ahead.
Intersection ahead.
Four-way stop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for other vehicles crossing your path.

questions.question: Traffic lights sometimes use arrows to control turns from certain lanes. A green arrow means:

options.text: It is only used on one-way streets.
You can go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
You may only proceed if there is also a circular green light.
It shows the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go. You must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Keep driving in your lane.
Pull to the right and stop.
Stop right where you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear a siren, pull to the right side of the road immediately and stop.

questions.question: If two drivers arrive at a four-way stop at the same time:

options.text: The driver on the right goes first.
The driver on the left goes first.
One driver can go without stopping.
One driver should honk to show they are giving up their turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right goes first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, if you and another driver arrive at the same time, let the driver on your right go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: Work zone signs mean:

options.text: It is summer.
You must stop and back up right away.
Driving conditions are not ideal.
Drive faster to leave the work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving conditions are not ideal.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange. They warn you that construction or maintenance work is happening on or near the road. Drive very carefully in these areas.

questions.question: If your wheels go off the road onto the shoulder, you should:

options.text: Brake hard and turn sharply back onto the road.
Stop your car at the edge of the road.
Slow down and turn back onto the road carefully.
Keep your speed and turn sharply back onto the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and turn back onto the road carefully.
questions.explanation: If your wheels go off the pavement onto the shoulder, slow down without braking hard. Turn back onto the road carefully. Watch for other traffic.

questions.question: You may drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road:

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you are in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pickup truck.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or carry open alcohol in a vehicle on any public road. This applies to all passengers and locations in the vehicle.

questions.question: You are driving on a narrow road and meet an oncoming vehicle. You must:

options.text: Pull completely off the road and stop.
Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road.
Tell the other vehicle to pull over.
Turn on your high beams so they see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road.
questions.explanation: On narrow roads, both vehicles must share the road equally. Each driver must give the other at least half of the road so both can pass safely.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.

options.text: Flashing yellow
Steady green
Steady red
Flashing red

questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns you that a red light is coming next.

questions.question: Orange signs are:

options.text: Work zone signs.
Regulatory signs.
School zone signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone signs.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs with black letters warn of work zones. They alert drivers that workers are on or near the highway.

questions.question: When passing other vehicles:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Return to your lane within 10 feet of the other vehicle.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your turn signal before changing lanes. Return to your lane only when you can see the front of the other vehicle in your mirror.

questions.question: When driving on ice or snow, what helps prevent crashes?

options.text: Add weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Leave the highway as quickly as possible.
Use four-wheel drive.
Slow down and stay farther from other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stay farther from other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Slow down on icy and snowy roads. Keep a larger distance between you and other vehicles. These are the best ways to avoid crashes in winter driving.

questions.question: When passing a large vehicle, what should a small vehicle driver be ready for?

options.text: Loud noises.
Extra air pollution.
Strong wind from the large vehicle.
Falling parts from the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Strong wind from the large vehicle.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles create strong wind gusts. These gusts can push smaller vehicles off course. Drivers of small vehicles should be ready to steer carefully when passing large vehicles.

questions.question: What does an arrow painted on the road mean?

options.text: Drivers may make the movement shown by the arrow if they want to.
Drivers must make the movement shown by the arrow only if traffic lights are broken.
Drivers must stop completely before making the movement shown by the arrow.
Drivers must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.
questions.explanation: An arrow on the road tells drivers they must turn in that direction. Drivers must follow traffic signs and signals while making this turn.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Signal before going forward.
Slow down and let trains pass.
Stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot move out of your way, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does a good defensive driver do?

options.text: Drives slowly all the time.
Watches what other drivers are doing.
Drives at the same speed all the time.
Only drives in areas they know well.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers are doing.
questions.explanation: Good defensive drivers watch other drivers closely. They expect problems and are ready to handle them.

questions.question: When there is a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line, with the broken line next to your lane, when can you pass?

options.text: Only in an emergency.
Only on an expressway.
When traffic ahead is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: When traffic ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: You can cross the broken yellow line to pass if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: How should you think about railroad crossings?

options.text: They are safe because trains rarely come.
They are dangerous.
They are safe places to park.
You must always stop at them.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are dangerous.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Always look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and flaggers. Only cross when you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach.
Your body weight.
The time between drinks.
All three of these.

questions.correctAnswerText: All three of these.
questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Food slows down how fast your body absorbs alcohol, but it cannot stop you from getting drunk if you drink too much.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield.
Crossroad ahead.
Keep right.
Yield ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield.
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in rain?

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.
No lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in rain.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow arrow traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane shown by the arrow.
Come to a complete stop.
Turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
Turn left immediately because you have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means you can turn left in that direction. But oncoming traffic has a green light, so you must wait and let them pass first.

questions.question: When you must stop at an intersection with no marked stop line or crosswalk, where should you stop?

options.text: You do not have to stop.
Slow down to check if traffic is clear.
Stop where you can see 200 feet on both sides, even if you enter the intersection.
Stop where you can see traffic coming before entering the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where you can see traffic coming before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic clearly. Do not enter the intersection to get a better view.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop?

options.text: Signal lights.
Other cars on the road.
The time of day.
The condition of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The condition of the road.
questions.explanation: Road conditions greatly affect your stopping ability. Slow down when roads are slippery or wet so you can stop safely if needed.
